subject.title: fix(ci): run Mantis Codex proof on Node 24

question: Is upstream action metadata enough proof for this private proof workflow, or should maintainers require an exact Mantis Telegram Desktop Proof rerun showing the Codex action under Node 24 before merge?
rationale: The contributor cannot run the secret-backed Mantis lane from a fork, and the PR's own Mantis checks were skipped, so only maintainers can supply or waive the exact private-infra proof.

options.title: Require exact proof rerun
options.body: Dispatch or otherwise observe this PR's modified Mantis Telegram Desktop Proof workflow and confirm the Codex action selects Node 24 before merge.

options.title: Accept metadata proof
options.body: Merge based on the upstream action metadata and source review, then monitor the next Mantis run for the Node runtime line.

options.title: Fold into broader action update
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100769 only if its stale-test and owner-review blockers are resolved first.

recommendation.title: Require exact proof rerun
recommendation.body: Dispatch or otherwise observe this PR's modified Mantis Telegram Desktop Proof workflow and confirm the Codex action selects Node 24 before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recent owner signal for the current workflow line and adjacent proof-artifact workflow behavior.
